items.title: Jharkhand to launch AI-powered portal to track medicine supply, curb misuse of prescription drugs
items.description: Jharkhand to launch an AI-powered portal to track medicine supply chains, flag suspicious drug sales, curb misuse, and let citizens report illegal sales.

items.title: PTR observatory to help plan human-elephant conflict management strategies
items.description: Palamu Tiger Reserve to set up elephant observatory using data and AI to reduce human-elephant conflict in Jharkhand, where 500+ died in 5 years.
